summary: Six ensuite bedrooms in two symmetrical single-storey wings flanking the pool. Sleeps up to 12 (+2 baby cots). Extra beds on request at additional cost.

rooms.name: Master Suites
rooms.body: Furthest from the main pavilion and closest to the beach, the two luxurious master suites face each other across the pool. Both feature a king-size four-poster bed, vanity area and silk upholstered couch. Lavish bathrooms have generous sunken bathtubs, a room-size walk-in rain shower, his & hers washbasins, and a small courtyard with modern glass sculptures beside a traditional Balinese water statue and pool. A terraced area offers cushioned outdoor furniture with privacy drapes and a private plunge pool overlooking the sea. Equipped with satellite TV and DVD player.

rooms.name: Queen Rooms
rooms.body: Next to the master suites, two Queen Rooms feature queen-size four-poster beds. Wood and glass sliding doors lead to chic ensuite bathrooms with mini-sunken baths that double as showers, in massage and traditional Balinese style.

rooms.name: Junior Rooms
rooms.bed: Twin beds (one canopied with mosquito net); can be configured for children
rooms.body: Accessed through internal sliding doors from each Queen Room, the adjoining Junior Rooms each have twin beds — one with canopied mosquito nets — making them very suitable for children. Positioned nearest the living pavilion for easy parental surveillance in the evenings. Ensuites with showers attached to both.
rooms.note: Quick Facts markets these as convertible to Kings — confirm with client.

sharedDetail: Interiors in all four (queen + junior) rooms follow the master-suite style; all bathrooms are sunlit via conservatory-style sloping glass roofs with rattan. Intimate patios are edged with white pebbles, black tiles and tropical foliage, with glass candle-holders and a black reclining lounger.
